notes: ACCESS: direct requests got HTTP 403 (WAF); curl_cffi impersonate='chrome131' fetched every page cleanly (HTTP 200). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (explicitly allows Claude-User). COUNT METHOD: site runs Laravel Livewire/Alpine; every PLP embeds an exact `totalProducts: N` counter in its initial Alpine state that drives the visible 'N of N products' header text (verified identical on every sampled page, e.g. mugs page literally renders '7 of 7 products') - this is a true exhaustive count, not a rounded/capped estimate, so used directly as qty. SCOPE: ProCook is a cookware/knife specialist, so per project convention (narrow scope like Lakeland/Sur La Table) only Tableware & Dining + Glassware/Drinkware were extracted; entire Cookware & Bakeware, Electricals, Kitchen Accessories, and Knives & Scissors departments were excluded wholesale (cookware/bakeware/appliances/utensils/cutlery/textiles all out of scope), as were Special Offers and Summer (seasonal promo rollups that re-list already-counted products). HIERARCHY MIRRORS DENBY (c135) CONVENTION: category='Kitchen & Dining' with parent groups Dinnerware Sets/Bowls/Plates/Drinkware/Glassware/Serveware/Table Accessories; Vases and String Lights broken out into their own categories like Denby's vases-to-'Home Accessories' split. DUPLICATE/ROLLUP HANDLING (drop, don't pad): '/shop/tableware-dining/dinner-sets' and '/shop/tableware-dining/serveware' and '/shop/drinkware/glasses' and '/shop/drinkware/hot-drinkware' and '/shop/drinkware/cafetieres-and-teapots' and '/shop/drinkware/drink-accessories' and every 'shop-all-*' URL are dead/empty hub-landing pages or explicit Shop-All rollups (no totalProducts counter, or a NEVER-EXTRACT Shop All page) - all dropped, their specific children counted instead. '/shop/drinkware/mugs' (20, title 'Mugs and Mug Sets') and '/shop/drinkware/gin-and-martini-glasses' (2) are duplicate cross-listings of products already counted under Tableware-Dining Mugs/Mug Sets and under Cocktail/Gin Glasses respectively - dropped to avoid double-counting the same catalogue items reached via a second nav path. '/shop/drinkware/milk-jugs-and-milk-frothers' (6: 4 milk jugs already duplicated inside Jugs and Carafes + 2 electric Milk Frother appliances) and '/shop/drinkware/tea-coffee-accessories' (13, entirely kitchen tools/appliance parts: tea infusers, milk frother, cafetiere glass, chocolate shaker, coffee stencils/tamper mat) dropped whole as appliance-dominated mixed rollups. '/shop/tableware-dining/placemats-coasters-napkins' (28, title 'Placemats, Coasters and Runners') dropped as a table-linens/textile category (fabric ribbed placemats+runners mixed with non-textile silicone/jute/slate pieces, same family as the excluded Tablecloths) - materials could not be reliably split from titles alone. '/shop/drinkware/reusable-water-bottles' (1 item, an insulated travel cup) and all of '/shop/drinkware/bar-wine-accessories' (28, corkscrews/jiggers/citrus juicers/bar tools), '/shop/drinkware/ice-cube-trays' (8), bottle-openers, straws dropped as bar-tool/kitchen-tool exclusions. MANUAL EXACT COUNTS FOR TWO MIXED LEAVES (titles individually verified, cutlery items subtracted rather than padding the raw site total): 'Cheese and Serving Boards' page reports 6 but 2 (Cheese Slicer, Cheese Knife Set) are cutlery -> qty 4. 'Kids Dinner Sets' page reports 16 but 4 (3x Silicone Toddler Cutlery Set + 1x Children's Cutlery Set) are cutlery -> qty 12. 'Table Decorations' page (tableware-accessories, 4 items) is an even 2-vase/2-string-light split, itemised by title into Vases and String Lights per Rule 0 (product type, not room/page name). DUPLICATE-COMPANY CHECK: ProCook is a standalone UK direct-to-consumer cookware/tableware retailer (not a private-label or sister brand of any other company already in this project) - no duplicate found.
